# Vendored: day-trader-skill

Source: https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/day-trader-skill
Commit: 3d0f4ef6986f4984b7c6bd46f7ff4f87744c3abd (2026-10-20)
License: MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Jake Schincariol) — see `LICENSE`.

This copy is read-only. Do not edit files here; apply changes in the adapter
(`investment_engine/day_trader/`). To update the vendor copy:

1. Clone the upstream repo at a new commit.
2. Diff against this folder.
3. Re-run `python -m unittest discover -s vendor/day_trader_skill/tests`.
4. Update `vendor/VENDORED_COMMIT` and this file with the new SHA.
5. Run the full test suite.

Excluded from the vendor copy: `.git/`.
Included: `.claude-plugin/`, `tests/`, `trader-*/`, `LICENSE`, `README.md`.
